mapper.insert: INSERT INTO codef_account_credentials ( codef_account_credential_id, user_id, issuer_id, connected_id, account_id_enc, account_password_enc, birth_date_enc, pending_card_number_enc, pending_card_password_enc, credential_identity_hash, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{codefAccountCredentialId}, #{userId}, #{issuerId}, #{connectedId}, #{accountIdEnc}, #{accountPasswordEnc}, #{birthDateEnc}, #{pendingCardNumberEnc}, #{pendingCardPasswordEnc}, #{credentialIdentityHash}, #{status}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT c.codef_account_credential_id, c.connected_id, i.institution_code, c.issuer_id, i.issuer_name, i.performance_lookback_months, c.birth_date_enc, i.requires_card_no, i.requires_card_password FROM codef_account_credentials c INNER JOIN issuers i ON i.issuer_id = c.issuer_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'active' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.codef_account_credential_id ASC
